findings.issue: ra-shell.jsx is a standalone preview shell that is no longer imported anywhere after all 4 ra-* screens were wired into AppShell via shell.jsx router. The file is either dead code or an intentional dev preview artifact — the commit message does not clarify the intent.
findings.suggestion: Add a comment '// standalone preview — intentionally kept for local dev' at the top, or remove the file. No functional regression possible.

findings.issue: confirmActor defaults to 'e-owner2' which is not a seeded admin employee; handleSecondConfirm bypasses validateAdminDelegation (checks only distinctness + confirmed2_by IS NULL). The second approver's admin authority is not re-verified on confirm2 by design (T-0044 rev-2). This is acceptable for the dev stand but the constraint is undocumented in the UI banner.
findings.suggestion: Add a hint in the dual-control banner that the second approver must hold admin authority, or add a comment to handleSecondConfirm explaining the intentional authority omission.
